name: Siege-Timber Golem

Traits.name: Unstoppable Bulk
Traits.text: While it moves, the siege-timber golem ignores difficult terrain made of rubble, splinters, or fallen timber, and any nonmagical wall, palisade, or door it moves into splinters apart as it strides through.
Traits.clause: The golem's lashed-timber bulk can't be held back by wood, stone, or barricade: while it moves, it ignores difficult ter
Traits.expressedQuote: any nonmagical wall, palisade, or door it moves into splinters apart as it strides through

Traits.name: Magic Resistance
Traits.text: The siege-timber golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The siege-timber golem makes two Lashed Fist attacks.

Actions.name: Lashed Fist
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 27 (5d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Trample (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: The siege-timber golem moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space it enters is targeted once by the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 16. *Failure:* 45 (13d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success:* Half damage only.
Actions.minorClause: , and the target has the Prone condition

lore: Built from the timbers of a dozen felled siege towers and animated by a warlord's final spiteful ritual, the siege-timber golem exists only to batter down every wall that stands before it.

generation.userConcept: a siege-engine golem of lashed timber that shoulders through walls

clauses.text: a siege-engine golem of lashed timber

generation.cite: composition after Flesh Golem (CR 5) — the made thing that cannot be unmade

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
